# Instructions

Implement a clock that handles times without dates.

You should be able to add and subtract minutes to it.

Two clocks that represent the same time should be equal to each other.


Public test command: cmake -S . -B build -DEXERCISM_RUN_ALL_TESTS=ON && cmake --build build. Implement the provided solution files; the grader restores the original tests.

Commands start in the task workspace. Use workspace-relative paths when possible.

Work in /app. Dependencies are preinstalled. python on PATH is the task interpreter. Internet access is unavailable; local services are allowed. Implement the request, run relevant checks, and summarize the actual result.
